invalidation.zh: 价格跌破2250，或融资费率Z-score升至>-20%，或日线趋势转熊（价格<SMA50 $2200）。
invalidation.en: Price breaks below 2250, or funding Z-score rises above -20%, or daily trend turns bearish (price < SMA50 $2200).

invalidation.zh: 价格跌破79.50（日线前低），或融资费率Z-score升至-50%以上（空头压力缓解），或日线趋势确认下跌（价格<SMA50 $85.56且持续）。
invalidation.en: Price breaks below 79.50 (daily low), or funding Z-score rises above -50% (short pressure eases), or daily trend confirms bearish (price < SMA50 $85.56 and sustained).

invalidation.zh: 价格跌破0.103（ATR支撑），或融资费率转正，或日线趋势转熊（价格<SMA50 $0.10）。
invalidation.en: Price breaks below 0.103 (ATR support), or funding turns positive, or daily trend turns bearish (price < SMA50 $0.10).
